title: Natural Earth 1:10 million: the first-order administrative divisions of the countries (states, provinces, prefectures, regions)
provider: Natural Earth (N. V. Kelso, T. Patterson and contributors), version 5.1.2, GeoJSON from the natural-earth-vector repository
format: GeoJSON; WGS 84 longitude and latitude in degrees; one (Multi)Polygon per division, cut at the antimeridian, with its codes (adm1_code, iso_3166_2, the country's adm0_a3 and iso_a2), its type and names in some 25 languages
coverage: The whole Earth at 1:10 million: about 4,600 divisions of some 250 countries and territories; Natural Earth's default (de facto) depiction of boundaries
citation: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
